name: neither-mcp
description: Decision memory with cited Decision/Rejected/Constraint/Citation via memory_for_file
long_description: Neither is decision memory for Cursor and Claude Desktop. This desktop extension runs a local stdio MCP server (Node 20+) bundled from @neitherai/mcp-server. Tools return cited Decision / Rejected / Constraint / Citation prose, including supersession. Requires a workspace API key (NEITHER_API_KEY). Get a workspace key at https://www.neither.online/start/?product=dev

tools.name: memory_for_file
tools.description: Cited Decision/Rejected/Constraint/Citation prose for a repo file path

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Natural-language search over workspace decision memory

tools.name: memory_snippet_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a verbatim snippet by provenance source_id

tools.name: memory_timeline
tools.description: Time-ordered memory view for a topic or anchor

tools.name: memory_push
tools.description: Close a decision or seed an ADR snippet with provenance

NEITHER_API_KEY.title: Neither API key
NEITHER_API_KEY.description: Workspace key (sk_ctx_…) from https://www.neither.online/start/?product=dev. Stored as a secret.

NEITHER_API_BASE.title: Neither API base
NEITHER_API_BASE.description: API host for the stdio MCP server. Leave the default unless you were given another host.
